decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter draws directly on the firm's curing, seasoning and slicing know-how and fits its strategic push into organic lines, so management can interpret early sales and refine it, although its brief website mention suggests somewhat lower visibility.

The organic poultry mini salami snack builds on established salami maturation expertise and the firm's organic and new-format expansion, and its dedicated product page signals commitment, so it is easy to assimilate and improve.
The premium sharing salami snack sits squarely within the firm's core premium salami competence and is presented on its own page, so related knowledge lets management learn from results and keep it.
